passage.title: Model answer written for TGA
paras: Shakespeare presents persuasion as more powerful than force. [Point] Antony repeats that 'Brutus is an honourable man' [Evidence] so often that the praise becomes ironic. [Technique] The adjective 'honourable' slowly empties of meaning, [Zoom in] and the crowd begins to hear accusation rather than respect. [Analyse] However, Antony may also be genuinely grieving, so his anger is real as well as useful. [Alternative] Ultimately, Shakespeare warns that words can overturn a state, so they must be used responsibly. [Link]
